text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
66 constants, named <resource>:<action>.
The 5 above map to audio:read, project:update,
user:delete, maqam:vote, physical_media:import.
13 resources: audio, video, image, text, category,
person, project, user, warning, correction, maqam,
physical_media, khi_logo.
Actions: read, create, update, remove (soft),
delete (hard).
The grid is NOT uniform: correction has no :create,
khi_logo no :remove, and 4 constants sit outside it -
maqam:vote, maqam:teacher_manage,
physical_media:import, physical_media:type_manage.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
ADMIN = EnumSet.allOf(Permission) and is locked:
granting or revoking per-user extras on an ADMIN is
refused with error code ADMIN_PERMISSIONS_LOCKED.
GUEST, EMPLOYEE and TEACHER all have an EMPTY role
baseline - every authority they hold comes from
extraPermissions.
applyRoleDefaults() copies EMPLOYEE_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS
(29 entries) or TEACHER_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS (maqam:read,
maqam:vote) in ONLY when extraPermissions is empty, so an
already-curated set is never overwritten; an admin may
then revoke any of them.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Effective authorities = role.getAuthorities()
(ROLE_ + name, plus the role's permissions) union
extraPermissions, each wrapped in a
SimpleGrantedAuthority.
isAccountNonExpired() is hardcoded true.
isAccountNonLocked() auto-unlocks: once
LOCK_DURATION_MINUTES (=1) has elapsed since
lockTime it reports unlocked without clearing
isLocked or failedAttempts.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
No FK to users_tbl.
isTokenBlacklisted() rejects if a row exists
here AT ALL - expiresAt is written on insert
and never read, and nothing purges the table.
It ALSO rejects when the token's sessionId is
unknown, or its Session is inactive or past
Session.expiresAt - revoking a Session kills
its token with no row here.
A 2-min Caffeine cache fronts both checks,
so a revoke can lag that long.
Filter answers 401 TOKEN_REVOKED.
